Question Choices: Fill: A quadrilateral has __ sides, __ angles, __ vertices (corners).
Solution: A quadrilateral is a closed polygon with four straight sides. Each adjacent pair meets at a vertex and makes an interior angle. Thus it has 4 sides,4 angles and 4 vertices.

Question Choices: A quadrilateral has one interior angle greater than 180°. Is it concave or convex?
Hints: An inward corner with an interior angle greater than 180° makes a polygon concave.
Solution: An interior angle greater than 180° is a reflex angle at an inward corner. A simple polygon with such a corner is concave.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has exactly one pair of parallel sides. What is this shape called? ~~Parallelogram | Trapezoid | Rectangle | Rhombus~~
Solution: Exactly one parallel pair makes this a trapezoid. A parallelogram, rectangle or rhombus has two parallel pairs.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A shape has 4 sides and 2 pairs of parallel sides. What is the most specific name for this shape? ~~Parallelogram | Trapezoid~~
Solution: Two pairs of parallel opposite sides meet the definition of a parallelogram. This is the most specific family guaranteed by the information.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral is a parallelogram and has four right angles but length of sides are not all equal. What is it called? ~~Rectangle | Square | Rhombus~~
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Four right angles make a rectangle. Unequal adjacent sides rule out a square and a rhombus; opposite sides form two parallel pairs.

Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has all sides the same length and opposite sides parallel but angles are not all right angles. What is it called? ~~Rectangle | Square | Rhombus~~
Hints: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Four right angles are also needed for a square.
Solution: Four equal sides make a rhombus. Without four right angles it is neither a rectangle nor a square.

Question Choices: Select. A quadrilateral has four right angles and all sides equal. Is this a square? ~~Yes | No~~
Solution: Yes. A square has four equal sides and four right angles. Therefore it is a rectangle, a rhombus, a parallelogram and a quadrilateral.

Question Choices: Select. Is every rectangle a parallelogram? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: Yes. A rectangle has four right angles and two pairs of parallel opposite sides, satisfying the parallelogram definition.

Question Choices: Select. Is every parallelogram a rectangle? ~~Yes | No~~
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: No. A parallelogram can have angles 60°,120°,60°,120°, so it need not have the four right angles required for a rectangle.

Question Choices: Select the correct option. A quadrilateral has four right angles and all sides equal. This shape belongs to which of the following families? ~~Rectangle | Square | Rhombus | All-above~~
Hints: Check the number of parallel pairs, right angles and equal sides. A shape may belong to several families.
Solution: A square has four equal sides and four right angles. Therefore it is a rectangle, a rhombus, a parallelogram and a quadrilateral. Thus every listed family applies:All-above.
